Question Choices: What general shape does a normal distribution have?
Hints: The graph has one central peak.;Both tails taper away.
Solution: A normal density is a symmetric bell-shaped curve with one peak at its mean. Its tails approach the horizontal axis in both directions. A roughly bell-shaped data plot may suggest, but does not by itself prove, a normal model.

Question Choices: A normal distribution is symmetric about which value?
Hints: The center is also the median and mode.;The halves mirror each other.
Solution: The normal curve is symmetric about the mean. Its mean, median and mode coincide, so the two halves mirror each other around that central value.

Question Choices: About what percent of normally distributed data lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean?
Hints: Use the empirical rule.;Recall the 68-95-99.7 pattern.
Solution: For a normal distribution, the empirical rule places approximately 68%, 95% and 99.7% within 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations, respectively. Thus within 1 standard deviations on either side of the mean is about 68%. These are approximations, not universal percentages for all distributions.

Question Choices: About what percent of normally distributed data lie within 2 standard deviations of the mean?
Hints: Use the second part of the empirical rule.;Recall 68-95-99.7.
Solution: For a normal distribution, the empirical rule places approximately 68%, 95% and 99.7% within 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations, respectively. Thus within 2 standard deviations on either side of the mean is about 95%. These are approximations, not universal percentages for all distributions.

Question Choices: Assume a normal distribution. Heights have mean 170 cm and standard deviation 5 cm. Between which two heights do about 68% of people fall? Enter the lower then upper value.
Hints: Go one standard deviation each way.;170 - 5 and 170 + 5.
Solution: The interval is mean plus or minus 1 standard deviation: 170-1(5)=165 and 170+1(5)=175. Enter the lower endpoint then the upper endpoint. Under the stated normal model this contains about 68% of values.
